description: This script manages prebuilt tools by refreshing timestamps, extracting tar files, and configuring build directories. It includes functions for updating timestamps, extracting tar archives, and handling command-line arguments for setting directories and tools. The script is primarily used to facilitate build environment setup and maintenance.

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Updates timestamps of all files in a specified directory.

methods.name: extract_prebuilt_tar
methods.description: Extracts contents from a specified tar archive.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps of build and staging directories, validating their existence.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Extracts tools tar and refreshes associated directories.
